summary.en: Heiji was invited to go to a real demon dog extermination, and invites Conan, Kogoro, and Ran to come with him and Kazuha. Five years ago, the womanizing chairman of the Inubushi group, Tsunechika Inubushi, died of terminal cancer. Due to his past habits, several people appeared, claiming to be related to Inubushi by presenting a picture of their mother with the president. Without the president or their mothers to confirm whether the claims were true or not, it became impossible to confirm or deny their claims. Regardless, the president's wife took in all eight people as her own adopted children. And now, with the president's wife ill herself, the inheritance is to be divided amongst the eight children. However, two out of eight died in strange ways recently. One fell off a cliff, and just before dying claimed that a fiery monster had assaulted him prior to the fall. Another had been assaulted by a dog on fire. Heiji and Conan head to the apartment of Shinichi Kudo (one of the adopted children, who, after learning about the two deaths, decided that his life was more important than the inheritance and thus left the Inubushis), but end up unable to meet with him because he is asleep. Thirty minutes later, they return to his room upon hearing a musical timer supposedly meant to wake him up, only to find his door sealed and Shinichi dead. Location: Shinichi Kudo's room Victim: Shinichi Kudo Cause of death: Carbon monoxide poisoning Suspects: Funae Abukawa Shinichi Kudo was found dead due to carbon monoxide poisoning in his room, the door and windows sealed shut via duct tape. Carbon monoxide was produced by a burning charcoal grill.
